name: Q2 Customer as Third-Party Beneficiary
text: Q2 should reject any deletion or qualification of the Q2 Customer third-party beneficiary clause. Q2 Customers (the financial institutions) do not have a separate agreement with Developer; their rights, including the right to enforce the indemnity, flow only through the third-party beneficiary clause.
fallback_1: Accept narrowing the 3PB right to specific sections clearly tied to Q2 Customer (use of Application, indemnity, confidentiality, data) provided indemnity and security obligations remain enforceable by Q2 Customer.
fallback_2: Accept a procedural requirement that Q2 Customer must enforce through Q2 in the first instance, provided this does not eliminate substantive rights.
fallback_3: If counterparty absolutely refuses third-party beneficiary status, escalate to GC; do not sign without senior counsel approval.
reviewer_note: Q2 Customers cannot be deleted from the agreement. Always retain the dedicated 'Q2 Customer as Third-Party Beneficiary' section verbatim. Q2 has consistently messaged this is 'a critical component of deal structure' and 'a commitment Q2 makes to the customers.'
preferred_language_1: Developer hereby agrees that Q2 Customer is a third-party beneficiary of this Agreement to the extent referenced herein and shall have the right, but not the obligation, to enforce this Agreement against Developer as a third-party beneficiary hereof.
suggested_comment_1: Q2 Customers (Q2's financial institution customers) require third-party beneficiary status because they have no direct agreement with Developer. Please reinstate.
suggested_comment_2: Q2 cannot remove third-party beneficiary status — this is a commitment Q2 has made to its customer base and a foundational element of the marketplace structure.
suggested_comment_3: If Q2 Customer third-party beneficiary status is removed, Q2's customers would have no enforceable rights under this agreement. This is a non-starter — Q2 will need to bring this to GC for review.
recommendation_prompt: Detect whether the agreement contains a 'Q2 Customer as Third-Party Beneficiary' provision and whether any redline modifies, deletes, or qualifies it. Flag any narrowing of the enforcement right or restriction on which sections Q2 Customer can enforce.
low_risk: Clause is included verbatim with full enforcement rights for Q2 Customer.
medium_risk: Clause is narrowed (e.g., enforcement limited to certain sections) but indemnity and security obligations remain enforceable by Q2 Customer.
high_risk: Clause is deleted entirely, or Q2 Customer's enforcement rights are eliminated.
